current_excerpt: Saving is blocked because the name is already used.
proposed_text: OPEN QUESTION for Bilal/Vlad + PO: does the build enforce UNIQUE role names? The spec (Create/Edit Custom Role) says 'Name (required, unique)', but the build shipped a soft 'Similar role already exists' confirmation that only triggers when BOTH the name AND the permission set are identical (C26337, verified) — it does NOT hard-block a duplicate name with a different permission set (C26339 marked Deviation). Decide the intended rule: (a) hard-block any duplicate name (update the build; keep this case asserting the block), or (b) the soft same-name+same-perms confirm is the intended behaviour (retire/rewrite this case, since C26337 already covers it). Do not push until resolved.
reason: Spec says role names are unique; build does not hard-enforce it (only a soft confirm on identical name+permissions). No ticket resolves the conflict — genuine product question, and a likely nightly false-fail.
citation: Spec 'Create / Edit Custom Role' ('Name (required, unique)') vs build soft-confirm (C26337 verified); no PO ruling on record.

proposed_text.custom_expected:
A window opens. It shows the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Settings sub-settings, the Work orders sub-settings (View mode, Review work orders, Pick parts, Order parts), and the Cross-Cutting Toggles (See Financial Data, Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable) for Senior Service Advisor. (Part History visibility now appears under the Parts group as 'View Part History', not as a cross-cutting toggle.) Everything in the window is read-only; clicking does nothing. The window closes when you close it.

NOTE (confirm live): the spec renamed the AP/AR toggle to 'Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable' (6/10) and relabelled 'View History Logs' to 'View Part History' under Parts (7/7); the build may still show the legacy labels until SV-8202 ships — see LABEL-BATCH.md.

citation: Spec change log 6/10 + 7/7; §5b; §1h; SV-8202 (open). See LABEL-BATCH.md.
